name: @konsulto/mcp
description: MCP server that enables Claude Code to drive the Konsulto cybersecurity audit platform from the CLI, including reading and writing findings, managing evidence, and handling scope and assets.

KONSULTO_PROFILE.description: Optional profile name to read a different credentials file (e.g., ~/.konsulto/credentials.acme).
